items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: I'm familiar with that name. And he was where they're eating at my dining room table. I had breakfast for them at my house and had dinner.

ctx.x: Your brother had that same long nose, exactly.

I see these girls here. This child here looks just like a white child. And this man here, where is he? The second man from here. I don't know his name is... And her father, her father was a white man. A doctor, Delahoussay. You know you're Delahoussay. I'm familiar with that name. And he was where they're eating at my dining room table. I had breakfast for them at my house and had dinner. See how little I used to be? And I wasn't smiling on this picture. The man took another one. He said, everybody's smiling at…
But all of your family then was quite late, I guess. Everybody in the family.
